fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to an enemy and strike it for 14 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Dust of the Drove
fusions.desc: Kicks a cone of dust and hoppers 3.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance per hit to leave them [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Unsaddled
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. For 4 seconds after you use it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Second Wind Aloft
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 25 seconds.
